data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger consolidation shows strong asset quality and operational efficiency. Loan growth moderating from high teens to sustainable mid-teens aligned with 1.3-1.4x nominal GDP growth. NIM compression expected due to increased competition and structural shift in deposit mix post-merger, stabilizing at 3.4-3.6%. CASA ratio gradually improving as legacy HDFC Ltd wholesale deposits mature and franchise strength drives retail deposits. Credit costs normalizing to best-in-class 0.8-1.0% reflecting superior underwriting. Operating leverage driving cost-to-income improvement from current elevated levels to sub-40% by FY30E. ROA improving to 2.0%+ and ROE expanding to 18%+ as merger synergies materialize and operational efficiencies scale. Capital adequacy remains robust above 17%, providing buffer for growth without equity dilution.
